hypothesis: After Request245 makes execution observability largely predictable, the remaining loss comes from ENTER versus WAIT timing. Inside the frozen causally tradable population, a chronological value model should learn whether entering now is better than waiting for the next admitted WATCH state under one fixed downstream HOLD/EXIT teacher.

admission.threshold_source: Request245 preregistered May5-8 threshold calibration; frozen before Request246 scoring
admission.label_contract: same Request245 immediate plus continuation tradability label

downstream_teacher.source: Request243 earlier teacher trained only on Apr30-May4

targets.enter_value: BASE return from entering at this admitted state and following the frozen teacher HOLD/EXIT sequence under the Request244 one-second execution contract
targets.wait_value: BASE return from skipping this state, entering at the next admitted WATCH state if one exists, then following the same frozen teacher HOLD/EXIT sequence; cash=0 only when no later admitted state exists

decision_rule: At an admitted state ENTER iff predicted enter_value > 0 and predicted enter_value >= predicted wait_value; otherwise WAIT and reconsider at the next observed WATCH state. Non-admitted states automatically WAIT.
baselines: first admitted state under the same frozen downstream HOLD/EXIT teacher
forbidden: changing the Request245 admission threshold after reading May11-20
using May11-20 to fit or tune entry-value models
using a best-future-state or max-future-return label
changing the frozen downstream HOLD/EXIT teacher
opening June or any new holdout
claiming promotion or live readiness from this development experiment
next_if_pass: Request247 should replace the weak frozen HOLD/EXIT teacher with a tradability-aware position-value learner, then join entry and position control.
next_if_fail: Audit whether the causal state can rank positive versus negative economic opportunity inside the tradable set before another controller iteration.
